mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods where FEDFUNDS declines by at least 0.25 percentage points over 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate rises above 4.0% (indicating economic stress), it triggers reduced corporate earnings expectations and flight to safety, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where UNRATE exceeds 4.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in housing starts (HOUST) and industrial production (INDPRO) signals robust economic expansion, with the interaction effect producing stronger positive equity returns than individual series.
failure_condition: The interaction term (HOUST * INDPRO) has negative Rank IC over any 12-month rolling window or combined effect is insignificant (p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: During high inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL > 3.5% YoY), the Federal Reserve tightens policy, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods where CPIAUCSL exceeds 3.5% YoY.

mechanism_narrative: A rising trend in residential investment (RSAFS) indicates strong consumer confidence and economic activity, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods where RSAFS increases by at least 0.5% month-over-month.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) falls below its 12-month moving average by more than 1.0%, it signals manufacturing slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where INDPRO falls below 12mo_MA by >1.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of rising housing starts (HOUST) and stable/declining federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals accommodative monetary policy supporting housing, producing positive equity returns through interaction.
failure_condition: The interaction term (HOUST * FEDFUNDS) has negative Rank IC over any 12-month rolling window or combined effect is insignificant (p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: During strong industrial production growth (INDPRO > 1.5% MoM), the economy enters a supply-driven expansion phase, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods where INDPRO growth exceeds 1.5% MoM.
